excluded.beauty: No matching complete candidate cache in local run.

protocol.reference_bank: All 128 archived histories; match stored priors and checkpoint metadata.
protocol.selection: Archived per-family budget_5pct validation choices; no new beta/estimator selection.
protocol.primary_signal: log(mean probability) minus mean(log probability), in training-catalog SD units
protocol.sensitivity_signal: log(M * sum(history_probability_weights ** 2)), in catalog SD units
controls: raw target score minus score of tenth candidate
protocol.outcome: Arithmetic hit minus geometric hit, with separately validation-selected strengths.
protocol.inference: Exploratory OLS, target-item clustered 95% intervals, no multiple-test adjustment.
protocol.transfer: Fit on validation; test reduction in MSE from adding primary signal to controls.
protocol.groups: Catalog-derived gap terciles; report both raw-miss recovery and raw-hit loss.
protocol.caveat: These datasets and outcomes were previously studied; this is not confirmatory evaluation.
